content.comment_body: Hello to the forum. I have a question: Is it possible to use the [product_name] [version_no] CPU (MAC ADDRESS [article_no]) together with an expansion module from [product_name] [version_no] DM8 24 (MAC ADDRESS [article_no])? Both operate at 24V DC. Thank you in advance.

No, the hardware for [article_no] and [article_no] [product_name] modules are not compatible. The current [product_name] [version_no] cannot work with expansion modules from the previous [product_name] generation.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is asking if a newer [product_name] CPU can be used with an older [product_name] expansion module, both operating at 24V DC. The answer clarifies that these hardware generations are not compatible, which could cause confusion for users attempting to mix different versions.
